llvm-objdump.version:
LLVM (http://llvm.org/):
  LLVM version 24.0.0git
  Optimized build.


  Registered Targets:
    amdgcn - legacy name for amdgpu
    amdgpu - AMDGPU gfx6+
    r600   - AMD GPUs HD2XXX-HD6XXX
    x86    - 32-bit X86: Pentium-Pro and above
    x86-64 - 64-bit X86: EM64T and AMD64

limits: Instruction counts are static ELF FUNC-symbol counts, not dynamic executions or bytes transferred.
Static resources and unchanged input hashes do not establish GPU correctness or performance.
Only descriptor bytes16..23 (kernel_code_entry_byte_offset) are normalized; all instruction bytes and metadata are exact.
